title: Λέξεις τῶν δέκα ῥητόρων / Lexicon of the Ten Orators / «Лексикон десяти ораторов»
author: Valerius Harpocration
genre: Special lexicon on the Attic orators (law, institutions, prosopography)
size: 1,247 entries (Harpokration On Line count). Estimate 30–35k words.
edition: W. Dindorf 1853 (PD). J. J. Keaney 1991 (in copyright).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Валерий Гарпократион) lists no translation. Searches in Russian found none.
en_evidence: Harpokration On Line (Duke DC3, Sosin et al.): all 1,247 entries translated, licensed CC BY 4.0. The complete draft was announced in 2016.
value: Key for Attic oratory, Athenian law and institutions, and prosopography. Preserves fragments of the Atthidographers and Aristotle's Ath. Pol. Essential for Russian historians of Athens and translators of the orators. RU-gap; the open English allows transparent cross-checking.
ai_feasibility: high: short factual entries; the CC BY English is available for comparison. Commentary should link each entry to the orators' passages.
pilot_unit: Legal and institutional entries in letters Α–Δ (about 300 entries; estimate 8k words).
